source: User-supplied Wave Race 64 USA revision 1 ROM on VENGEANCE
method: Locally decoded ADPCM samples from bank0, selected by sequence0's channel2/channel5 IO0 and IO5 commands. Sixteen standalone mono WAV effects cover52 note selectors. An additional ice-break cue renders sequence0/channel7 dynamic-call19: five notes across three layers, bank5/instrument7. The original bank-set resolver confirms these physical banks.
tools: Existing REA/Ghidra analysis on EVO X2
mix: Original samples and tuning; approximate7.5ms envelope steps and150ms release,2s note hold for the drum effects. Variants share rendered base effects with original relative pitch and pan. Velocity is squared as in the original note interpreter. Ice uses offline SoundFont rendering with approximate envelopes/reverb and explicit peak scaling; its audible tail is faded after480ms and its silent tail preserves the194-tick routine plus8-tick poll wait. Its shared channel coalesces repeated hits. Browser bus gain, scheduling, stereo placement, resampling and tails are adaptations, not bit-exact N64 RSP output. Original engine loops and voice scheduling remain unfinished.
